notes: «حدثناه» is the verb for this same hadith, not a back-reference: its object is the saying, not a name
«فذكر بمثل حديث عقيل عن الزهري» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, never a route (rule 4)
«كلهم عن يعقوب» makes the three shaykhs one level; «أبي» is the father of يعقوب, named only by relation; «سعيد بن العاص» is occurrence 2, the one after «أن»
